historical_root_hash_explanation: Directory path is provenance, not a single SHA. Binding uses each current config, copied runtime config, started/completed receipt, raw metrics, suite, source_manifest, runtime scripts and the 190 source files. Checkpoint files are existence-only and are NOT historically hash-bound by these receipts.

metric_definitions.aaa_sample_weighted: mean of ten native CNN top1 values; distinct from task macro AAA
metric_definitions.native_AAA_warning: Native final AAA is mean of all55 lower-triangle cells, not stage-task AAA.

reuse_scope.data_rng: Native src.main/src.trainer; set_random(2) once at initial training setup; native DataLoader global RNG, no new wrapper epoch reseeding. There are no historical per-step batch identity traces.
reuse_scope.diagnostic_flags: mechanism_eval=True and mechanism_grad_stats=True; retain shared_config in full. Extra anchor/future/flat/probe switches are false.
reuse_scope.extension_requirement: Retain historical native loader, diagnostic flags, optimizer/projector and schedule; restrict new implementation to final direction selection plus output provenance.
reuse_scope.checkpoint_caveat: File sets exist; historical completed receipts do not bind checkpoint hashes; no current checkpoint tensor content verification.
